property_summary: For any transfer call that succeeds, the i-th outgoing transferFrom call to the recipient must encode the i-th amount v[i], so a recording counterparty's accumulated sum of received amounts equals the sum of v; the buggy version always encodes v[0] and so, for v[1] != v[0], makes the observed total differ from sum(v).
change_summary: Change the calldata argument for the amount from v[i] to v[0], causing the same amount to be used for every transfer and changing observable behavior when _tos.length > 1 or i > 0.
